epic.title: User Onboarding & Identity Management
epic.body: Centralized management of user lifecycles, enabling the secure creation and onboarding of students, teachers, administrators, and support staff with role-specific data validation.

features.title: Staff Provisioning (Teachers, Admin, Transport)
features.body: Enable administrators to register staff members (Teachers, Drivers, Transport Managers) with attributes specific to their roles, such as subject expertise or employee IDs.

stories.title: Create Staff User API
stories.body: Implement backend endpoint to create staff users. Must accept specific fields based on role (e.g., 'subjects' for Teachers, 'license' for Drivers).
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint validates mandatory fields (Name, Email, Phone, Role)
Ensures Email and Phone are unique across the system
Persists role-specific data (e.g., ClassAssigned, Subjects) for Teachers

stories.title: Staff Creation Interface
stories.body: Develop the 'Add User' modal form to support Staff roles as per the prototype designs.
acceptanceCriteria: Form displays dynamic fields when 'Teacher' role is selected (Subjects, Classes)
Form hides irrelevant fields (e.g., Parent Details) when creating staff
Validates required fields before submission
Success notification upon user creation

features.title: Student & Parent Enrollment
features.body: Streamlined process to register students, assign them to classes, and simultaneously link/create their parent or guardian profiles.

stories.title: Create Student with Parent Link API
stories.body: Backend logic to create a Student user and an associated Parent profile in a single transaction or link to an existing parent.
acceptanceCriteria: Validates Student basic info (Name, Class, Roll Number)
Validates Parent info (Name, Phone, Email)
Creates relationship between Student and Parent entities
Ensures Student is assigned to a valid Class Section

stories.title: Student Registration Form
stories.body: Implement the 'Student' role selection in the Add User form which reveals the Parent Details section.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting 'Student' reveals 'Parent Details' section (Name, Phone, Email)
Includes fields for Roll Number, DOB, and Blood Group
Client-side validation ensures Parent details are filled
Supports assigning the student to a specific class from a dropdown

features.title: User Directory & Search
features.body: A searchable and filterable view of all system users to allow admins to manage existing accounts efficiently.

stories.title: Fetch Users API with Filters
stories.body: API to retrieve paginated list of users with support for filtering by Role and searching by Name/Email.
acceptanceCriteria: Supports pagination (limit/offset)
Filters by Role (Teacher, Student, Admin, etc.)
Search query applies to Name and Email fields
Returns appropriate metadata (Total count)

stories.title: User Management Dashboard UI
stories.body: Implement the user list table with search bar, role filter tabs, and action buttons (Edit/Delete).
acceptanceCriteria: Displays users with Role icons (GraduationCap, BookOpen, etc.)
Implements 'Search' input to filter the list client-side or server-side
Implements Role filter dropdown/tabs
Shows 'Edit' and 'Delete' actions for each row
